column1: # SE4. id CL-01 upward. heuristic H1 to H10 (primary; the secondary goes in the problem text). severity 0 to 4 on the D1 scale

column4: problem

column3: Launching the tool (Window menu, Unity Editor)
column4: The page can only be made inside the Unity Editor via Window > ChangeLens Producer Page; the intended reader is a producer who, per the proxy scenario, does not open Unity, and the Editor gives no cue the tool exists. Nothing outside Unity makes or delivers the page. (Also H6: the entry must be recalled, not recognised.)
Two entries: 'ChangeLens' (the A2 prototype that sorts a log file) and 'ChangeLens Producer Page'. The shorter, listed first, is a different tool with a different input.

git failures are shown raw. A folder that is not a clone gives 'Could not build the page: git log --first-parent --no-color "--format=%H%x09%aI" failed: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git' (reproduced with the shared code). If git is not on the PATH (a README requirement the window never states) the user gets a .NET process-start exception (inferred from the code, not reproduced). Neither says what to do.

column3: From repository > Repository field and Browse dialog ('Choose a git repository')
column4: Assumes the user has a local git clone and knows where it is; no hint says which folder to pick or that the Unity project folder will do. A pasted web address gives 'No folder at: https://...'.

The dialog opens on the last reopened study-week folder, and saving writes export/ plus five files with silent overwrite: accepting the default replaces an earlier saved week, including the committed study pages, with no confirmation (also H3: no undo).

column3: Save study files... (label and output folder)
column4: 'Save this page' is only available as 'Save study files', and it writes research material: both report versions, fidelity-A/B checklists, naming.md ('Deliverable 2 measures ... target 90%') and export/ with the raw git log, which carries contributors' names and e-mail addresses. No single shareable page (PDF/HTML), Markdown only; the producer cannot tell which file to send and may share the e-mails (also H5).
Success message reads '<title>: 7 commits, 39 file changes, claims A 14 / B 28' while the page says 'changes'; 'claims' is never explained; no button to open the saved folder.

column3: Toolbars and hints: 'Frozen study week', 'Version A (baseline)', 'Version B (treatment)', 'the study folder is one level above the Unity project'
column4: Experiment vocabulary in the producer's interface. 'Treatment' does not say it adds the scene and prefab list; 'Frozen study week' does not read as 'open a saved week'.

column3: Generate after a failed check; editing inputs after a page is shown
column4: When the date or folder check fails, the previous page stays drawn under the red error (the code calls Fail without clearing the reports), and editing Repository/Week starts/Days does not mark the shown page as stale. Save stays enabled and saves the old week. The user cannot tell whether the page matches the fields.

column3: Frozen study week > Generate (Feb seed week)
column4: Reopening a saved week rebuilds the page from export/ with the current code instead of showing the saved report. For 2021-02-08 Version B shows 25 scenes and prefabs and Wet Floor Sign 'moved ... and rebuilt', while the saved report-B-treatment.md says 26 with the sign added and deleted. The window gives no sign that the reopened page differs from the one that was saved and shared. (July matches.)

column3: Version B > Scenes and prefabs changed, entry lines
column4: Entry lines mix producer translations ('UI layout', 'physics body', 'object setup') with raw Unity names ('Canvas Renderer', 'Animator', 'Canvas Group', 'NetworkIdentity script', 'Audio Source', 'placed-prefab overrides', 'script settings'). Example, Server Lobby: 'added new objects, UI layout, Animator, Canvas Renderer and 9 more; removed objects, placed-prefab overrides, position/rotation/scale, ServerLobbyUIHelper script and 2 more; edited Light.' A non-coding producer cannot turn most entries into a tester ask, and this section is the treatment's whole addition.

column3: Version B: 'Where the work went' row vs 'Scenes and prefabs changed' line
column4: Two different scene/prefab numbers with no stated link: 35 file changes vs '26 scenes and prefabs changed' (Feb), 26 vs 24 (July). A reader quoting either in an update can be contradicted by the other.

column3: Saved Feb report-B-treatment.md, Wet Floor Sign entries
column4: The committed study page lists Wet Floor Sign twice, in two folders ('new prefab added' and 'prefab deleted'), which reads as two signs rather than one moved and rebuilt prefab. Current code merges them, but readers get the saved page.

The tool's uncertainty leaks into the page without explanation: 'removed LoadingScreenManager or TileBase script', 'an unidentified script', and a footer note that scripts the project does not contain 'count together as one'.

column3: Version B, 'objects named in the change' lines
column4: Generic Unity object names (Text, Text (TMP), Panel, Image, GameObject, Placeholder, Buttons) fill most of these lines and crowd out the meaningful ones (ChatButton, ExpandBodyButton, Body Parts).

Entries are grouped by asset in an unstated order; to see what one change touched (e.g. #588 touches 8 entries) the reader scans every entry for the quoted title and remembers them. No link from a row in the changes table to its scene/prefab entries.

column3: Both versions: art, audio and code
column4: Art, audio and code changes are counts only; no art or audio file is named in either version, so 'what art changed' can only be guessed from change titles.

Heading says 'week of 2021-02-08' (ISO), header says '10 February 2021 to 14 February 2021' (first and last change, in each author's local date). Nothing says the range is the changes, not the week asked for, and a local date can fall outside the UTC week.

The page is drawn with GUILayout labels, so text cannot be selected or copied, and there is no copy, print or export of the single page on screen. A status update has to be retyped or taken from the saved .md file.

No help in the window: no link to a guide, no explanation of the two versions or of 'file change' outside the page itself; only 'Week starts' has a tooltip. The guide that exists (TRY-CHANGELENS.md) is written for an evaluator (tests, SE2, reserve weeks), not a producer.
Free-text date field that accepts only yyyy-mm-dd, with no date picker, so an Australian producer's natural 19/07/2021 is rejected (recovery is good; see strengths). Days is silently clamped to 1-31.

git runs synchronously under a progress bar fixed at 30% ('Running git log for the week...') with no cancel (also H3); on the guide's blobless clone the patch step may fetch file contents over the network. Duration not observed (no hands-on timing).

After the red 'No commits found' error, the empty page ('(no dates) · 0 changes by 0 people', empty table) is still shown and Save study files stays enabled, saving a 0-change week ('claims A 6 / B 6').
Shares are listed for four areas only and sum to 68% (Feb) / 90% (July) because supporting files sit on a separate line; 'Largest area this week' repeats the table.
